name: UTS Housing Rental Subsidy
summary: Rent subsidy for local UTS students on a UTS Housing lease at Yura Mudang.
key: Awards usually range between $1,500 to $2,500 for a 26 week period.
who: Current UTS Housing lease at Yura Mudang
how: Submit the online application with a copy of your current lease
catches: A maximum of 2 subsidy awards per year
May be reduced for shorter leases

evidence.quote: HRS awards usually range between $1,500 to $2,500 for a 26 week period
